offense_title: No handbook offense or insufficient evidence

texts.en: The student entered through the designated gate in complete uniform and presented a valid University ID to security.
texts.tl: Pumasok ang estudyante sa tamang gate na kumpleto ang uniporme at ipinakita ang balidong University ID sa guwardiya.
texts.taglish: Dumaan ang student sa designated gate in complete uniform at maayos na nag-present ng valid University ID sa security.

texts.en: A faculty member authorized the class officers to move the chairs before the scheduled student presentation.
texts.tl: Pinahintulutan ng guro ang mga opisyal ng klase na ilipat ang mga upuan bago ang nakatakdang presentasyon.
texts.taglish: May permission ng faculty ang class officers na i-rearrange ang chairs bago ang scheduled presentation.

texts.en: The student ate lunch at the cafeteria and placed the food containers in the proper waste bins afterward.
texts.tl: Kumain ng tanghalian ang estudyante sa kantina at itinapon pagkatapos ang mga lalagyan sa wastong basurahan.
texts.taglish: Nag-lunch ang student sa cafeteria at pagkatapos ay nilagay ang food containers sa tamang waste bins.

texts.en: The student borrowed a general-circulation book through the library desk and returned it before the recorded due date.
texts.tl: Humiram ang estudyante ng aklat na maaaring iuwi sa library circulation desk at isinauli ito bago ang takdang petsa.
texts.taglish: Nag-borrow ang student ng general-circulation book sa library desk at ibinalik ito before the due date.

texts.en: Before the laboratory exercise, the technician installed an approved application; the student only used it for the assigned activity.
texts.tl: Bago ang laboratory exercise, ang technician ang nag-install ng aprubadong application; ginamit lamang ito ng estudyante para sa nakatalagang gawain.
texts.taglish: Before the lab exercise, ang technician ang nag-install ng approved application; ginamit lang ito ng student for the assigned activity.

texts.en: The student signed in to the University portal using the account issued to them and accessed only their own enrollment record.
texts.tl: Nag-sign in ang estudyante sa University portal gamit ang sariling account at sariling enrollment record lamang ang binuksan.
texts.taglish: Gamit ang assigned account, nag-login ang student sa University portal at sariling enrollment record lang ang in-access.

texts.en: The instructor permitted generative AI for brainstorming, and the student disclosed its use and completed the required analysis independently.
texts.tl: Pinayagan ng guro ang generative AI para sa brainstorming, at idineklara ng estudyante ang paggamit nito habang sariling gawa ang pagsusuri.
texts.taglish: Allowed ng instructor ang Gen AI for brainstorming; dineclare ito ng student at sariling analysis pa rin ang isinumite.

texts.en: After finding an unattended wallet in the lobby, the student immediately surrendered it to the Student Discipline Office.
texts.tl: Matapos makakita ng pitakang walang nagbabantay sa lobby, agad itong isinuko ng estudyante sa Student Discipline Office.
texts.taglish: May nakitang unattended wallet ang student sa lobby at agad niya itong tinurn over sa Student Discipline Office.

texts.en: A recognized student organization sold approved event merchandise at a booth covered by a written campus permit.
texts.tl: Nagbenta ang kinikilalang organisasyon ng aprubadong event merchandise sa booth na may nakasulat na pahintulot ng kampus.
texts.taglish: Nagbenta ang recognized student organization ng approved event merchandise sa booth na may written campus permit.

texts.en: The student brought prescribed medicine in its labeled container and presented the current prescription to Health Services.
texts.tl: Nagdala ang estudyante ng niresetang gamot sa may label na lalagyan at ipinakita ang kasalukuyang reseta sa Health Services.
texts.taglish: May dalang prescribed medicine ang student in a labeled container at naipakita niya ang valid prescription sa Health Services.

texts.en: After all answer sheets were collected, the proctor allowed the student to retrieve the phone stored at the front of the room.
texts.tl: Matapos makolekta ang lahat ng answer sheet, pinayagan ng proctor ang estudyante na kunin ang teleponong iniwan sa harap.
texts.taglish: After makolekta ang answer sheets, pinayagan ng proctor ang student na kunin ang phone na naka-store sa harap.

texts.en: The report merely calls a student near a building suspicious but identifies no action, witness, or supporting detail.
texts.tl: Tinawag lamang sa ulat na kahina-hinala ang isang estudyante malapit sa gusali ngunit walang tinukoy na ginawa, saksi, o sumusuportang detalye.
texts.taglish: Tinawag lang sa report na suspicious ang student near a building pero walang identified action, witness, o supporting detail.

texts.en: When security requested identification during a routine check, the student immediately presented their own valid University ID and cooperated.
texts.tl: Nang hingin ng security ang pagkakakilanlan sa regular na inspeksiyon, agad ipinakita ng estudyante ang sariling balidong University ID at nakipagtulungan.
texts.taglish: During a routine check, agad ipinakita ng student sa security ang sariling valid University ID at fully siyang nag-cooperate.

texts.en: Under the laboratory technician's supervision, the student used an assigned computer to perform an authorized network-diagnostics exercise.
texts.tl: Sa ilalim ng pagbabantay ng laboratory technician, ginamit ng estudyante ang nakatalagang computer para sa awtorisadong network-diagnostics exercise.
texts.taglish: Under the lab technician's supervision, ginamit ng student ang assigned computer for an authorized network-diagnostics exercise.

texts.en: Two students firmly disagreed about a project deadline, but neither used insults, threats, sexual remarks, repeated messages, or physical force.
texts.tl: Mahigpit na hindi nagkasundo ang dalawang estudyante tungkol sa deadline ng proyekto, ngunit walang insulto, pagbabanta, seksuwal na pahayag, paulit-ulit na mensahe, o puwersa.
texts.taglish: Firmly nag-disagree ang two students about the project deadline, pero walang insults, threats, sexual remarks, repeated messages, or physical force.

texts.en: A recognized organization posted a University-approved announcement for a voluntary religious-literacy forum without recruiting or pressuring students.
texts.tl: Nagpaskil ang kinikilalang organisasyon ng aprubadong anunsiyo para sa boluntaryong forum tungkol sa kaalamang panrelihiyon nang walang panghihikayat o pamimilit.
texts.taglish: Nag-post ang recognized organization ng University-approved announcement for a voluntary religious-literacy forum without recruiting or pressuring students.

texts.en: At the student's request, the librarian placed a reference book on the official reserve shelf for the student's scheduled research appointment.
texts.tl: Sa kahilingan ng estudyante, inilagay ng librarian ang reference book sa opisyal na reserve shelf para sa nakatakdang research appointment.
texts.taglish: At the student's request, ang librarian ang naglagay ng reference book sa official reserve shelf for the scheduled research appointment.

texts.en: The student held a dizzy classmate's arm only to prevent a fall and escorted the classmate directly to Health Services.
texts.tl: Hinawakan ng estudyante ang braso ng nahihilong kaklase upang hindi ito matumba at agad itong inihatid sa Health Services.
texts.taglish: Hinawakan ng student ang arm ng dizzy classmate only to prevent a fall at inescort siya directly to Health Services.

texts.en: The complainant heard from an unidentified person that someone might have brought a vape, but named no student, witness, time, place, or observed item.
texts.tl: Narinig umano ng complainant mula sa hindi kilalang tao na baka may nagdala ng vape, ngunit walang tinukoy na estudyante, saksi, oras, lugar, o nakitang bagay.
texts.taglish: May narinig daw ang complainant from an unidentified person na baka may dalang vape, pero walang named student, witness, time, place, or observed item.

texts.en: The student wore the costume assigned by the faculty director during an officially approved theater rehearsal and changed afterward.
texts.tl: Isinuot ng estudyante ang costume na itinalaga ng faculty director sa opisyal na aprubadong theater rehearsal at nagpalit pagkatapos.
texts.taglish: Wore ng student ang costume assigned by the faculty director during an officially approved theater rehearsal at nag-change afterward.

texts.en: Students waited quietly in the corridor during the scheduled break while the next classroom was being prepared.
texts.tl: Tahimik na naghintay ang mga estudyante sa corridor sa oras ng break habang inihahanda ang susunod na silid-aralan.
texts.taglish: Tahimik na naghintay ang students sa corridor during the scheduled break habang pineprepare ang next classroom.

texts.en: The laboratory class used University-issued microscopes and sensor probes under faculty supervision and returned every item after the activity.
texts.tl: Gumamit ang laboratory class ng mga microscope at sensor probe ng University sa ilalim ng pagbabantay ng guro at isinauli ang lahat pagkatapos.
texts.taglish: The lab class used University-issued microscopes and sensor probes under faculty supervision at ibinalik nang kumpleto ang equipment after the activity.

texts.en: During an approved interfaith dialogue, the student respectfully explained personal beliefs without criticizing anyone else's faith.
texts.tl: Sa aprubadong interfaith dialogue, magalang na ipinaliwanag ng estudyante ang sariling paniniwala nang hindi hinahamak ang pananampalataya ng iba.
texts.taglish: During the approved interfaith dialogue, respectfully nag-share ang student ng beliefs without attacking anyone else's faith.

texts.en: Two group members disagreed about task assignments in the class chat but exchanged no insults, threats, or repeated harassment.
texts.tl: Hindi nagkasundo ang dalawang miyembro tungkol sa hatian ng gawain sa class chat ngunit walang insulto, pagbabanta, o paulit-ulit na pang-aapi.
texts.taglish: Nag-disagree ang two group members about task assignments sa class chat pero walang insult, threat, or repeated harassment.

texts.en: The student quietly read a library book at a study table and placed it on the designated return cart afterward.
texts.tl: Tahimik na nagbasa ang estudyante ng aklat sa study table ng library at inilagay ito sa nakatalagang return cart pagkatapos.
texts.taglish: Tahimik na nagbasa ang student ng library book sa study table at inilagay ito sa designated return cart afterward.

texts.en: The student stopped at the restricted laboratory entrance, requested authorization, and entered only after the technician approved access.
texts.tl: Huminto ang estudyante sa pasukan ng restricted laboratory, humingi ng pahintulot, at pumasok lamang matapos aprubahan ng technician.
texts.taglish: Nag-stop ang student sa restricted lab entrance, humingi ng authorization, at pumasok lang after approval ng technician.

texts.en: The similarity report flagged properly quoted passages, and the instructor confirmed that every source was cited according to the required format.
texts.tl: Na-flag sa similarity report ang mga wastong sipi, at kinumpirma ng guro na kumpleto at tama ang pagkakabanggit sa lahat ng sanggunian.
texts.taglish: Na-flag ng similarity report ang properly quoted passages, pero kinumpirma ng instructor na complete at correct ang citations.

texts.en: An anonymous note alleges inappropriate behavior during an event but gives no person, act, time, location, or evidence to evaluate.
texts.tl: May anonymous note na nagsasabing may hindi angkop na asal sa isang event ngunit walang tao, kilos, oras, lugar, o ebidensiyang matutukoy.
texts.taglish: May anonymous note na nag-aallege ng inappropriate behavior during an event, pero wala itong identified person, specific act, time, location, or evidence.
